# mtncloud_budget (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud budget data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_budget" "example" {
  name = "example budget"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud budget.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
